nodes.summary: If $s^\top B s \ne 0$ and $y^\top s \ne 0$, the BFGS update satisfies the secant equation the defining property of quasi-Newton updates: along the last step, $B_+$ reproduces the change of the gradient, as the true Hessian does for a quadratic.
nodes.title: The BFGS update satisfies the secant equation

nodes.summary: If $B$ is symmetric and positive definite, $s \ne 0$ and the curvature condition $y^\top s > 0$ holds, then the BFGS update $B_+$ is positive definite.
nodes.title: The BFGS update preserves positive definiteness under the curvature condition

nodes.summary: If $B$ is symmetric ($\langle Bu, v \rangle = \langle u, Bv \rangle$ for all $u, v$), so is its BFGS update $B_+$: the two corrections $(Bs)(Bs)^\top$ and $y y^\top$ are symmetric.
nodes.title: The BFGS update preserves symmetry

nodes.summary: For a Hessian approximation $B$, a step $s = x_+ - x$ and a gradient change $y = \nabla f(x_+) - \nabla f(x)$, the BFGS update (Broyden, Fletcher, Goldfarb and Shanno, 1970) is that is $B_+ v = Bv - \frac{(Bs)^\top v}{s^\top B s}\, Bs + \frac{y^\top v}{y^\top s}\, y$. It is a symmetric correction of rank at most two that satisfies the secant equation $B_+ s = y$ and keeps $B$ positive definite when $y^\top s > 0$.
nodes.title: BFGS update

can_prove.label: ready to prove

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
